The source projected atom arrangement and larger carbon glyph remain; the hollow wedge has a widened straight base tangent to H3, avoiding an artificial sliver inside the atom outline; H4 is moved farther along its same depth direction so each dash is 15.083 mm long with 7.6 mm clear gaps, making the depth breaks distinguishable from ordinary Index dot cadence.
